Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, these are the free half-hours I have:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Could you let me know which one works for you (or suggest another slot within working hours)? I'll put it on my calendar as soon as you confirm.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — my 10:00-10:30 is free and it sits right before my paper review. Please put it on your calendar; it is on mine now.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Monday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar now. Thank you — see you then.

Best,
Sarah
